c74object.name: bachmcp.generator
c74object.description: Typed in a box, becomes a bpatcher of bachmcp.bpatcher.generator: bachmcp.algo.generate with its bachmcp.gui.params panel and two bachmcp.translate, ready to connect to a bach.roll. The first argument is the instance's name.

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: The name the model and the server know this instance by. Unique across open patches.
